title: BankIndexConflict

bytes.description: The fixed tiers' size, in bytes, under the first scope that is over.

items.description: A bank's name: 1 to 40 characters of lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens between them, unique per environment.

banks.description: The banks whose fixed tiers add up past the limit, by name.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

account.description: The account, or all for every account.

anyOf.description: A repository identity: the one form every spelling of a repository's remote comes down to, https:// then the host without its port and the path of two segments or more, in lower case (repositoryIdentityOf and cases/repository-identity.json). An identity, not a link.

repository.description: The repository, or all for every repository.

scopes.description: The account and repository scopes under which they do.

description: The data of a conflict with reason index_too_large: the banks and the scopes under which their fixed tiers would pass 8 KB.
